rules.function_unit: one independently invokable function per function node
rules.invocation_unit: one target function per request; one function may be called repeatedly
rules.publication: provider verification + capability publication + UI contribution; all external
rules.revisit: revision-driven invalidation and re-verification; all external
rules.blockers: cause, evidence, impact, remedies, safe attempts, verification; all external
rules.safe_failover: missing providers degrade to documentation and validation only
rules.ui_fallback: every validated function has a Raw UI draft; unverified functions are not invokable
rules.commit: external revision-aware atomic visibility; Forge returns recipes, not commits
rules.invalidation: external reverse-index lookup, UI revocation and lease-based reconsideration
rules.blocker_explanation: cause + evidence + impact + remedies required before diagnosis is considered complete
rules.provider_negotiation: Pure external snapshot matching; no bound providers or authorization; host must recheck live identity, policy and revision
rules.events: Pure projection of externally supplied ordered events with externally owned cursor; no subscription, cursor writes or UI effects
rules.integration: Derived host invocation intents only; every actual call requires exact live runtime re-authorization and compare-and-swap revision checks
rules.visibility: Receipt/revision consistency inspection only; UI provider must independently authenticate and confirm actual state

provider_ports.purpose: external bidirectional dependency and provenance queries
external queue and leases; no duplicate queue
dynamic provider discovery and typed invocation
expose verified actions in Raw UI / composers
immutable evidence and external audit history
